items.title: One of the biggest marketing mistakes in football history?
items.summary:
One of the biggest marketing mistakes in football history?

Nike signed Lionel Messi when he was just 14 years old, and he even wore Nike boots during the early years of his Barcelona career.

According to multiple reports, the relationship began to break down after Jorge Messi requested additional Nike sports kits for the family, a request that reportedly went unanswered. Adidas took advantage of the situation and offered Messi a contract worth around $1 million per year, which he accepted in early 2006.

Nike then took legal action, claiming Messi had breached their agreement. However, the court ruled in Messi’s favor because Nike’s document was only a letter of intent, not a legally binding contract.

The rest is history.

Messi went on to win 8 Ballons d’Or, lift the 2022 World Cup, and sign a lifetime partnership with Adidas, becoming one of the brand’s greatest ambassadors.

Nike didn’t just lose a rising star. It lost the opportunity to sponsor the greatest player of all time.
